entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Abyssin reach adulthood at age 30 and can live up to 300 years thanks to their regenerative abilities.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Abyssin's violent and anarchic upbringing cause them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Abyssin stand around 6 feet tall and weigh between 200 and 400 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Rapidly Regenerative
entries: You heal quickly, both at will and in response to danger. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can choose to spend one of your Hit Dice to recover {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. Additionally, when you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a Hit Die to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} as long as the damage would not reduce your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to 0.

entries.name: Rugged Survivalist
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill. Additionally, you are naturally adapted to hot climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

entries.name: Tech-Impaired
entries: While abyssin can figure out basic technology, they experience difficulty using more complex equipment like wristpads. You can not use {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or take levels in {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} classes.

entries.name: Savage Attacks
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Abyssin. Abyssin uses mainly growls and grunts that many species consider primitive. The written form of language uses only a small number of simple hieroglyphs.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Advozsec reach adulthood in their late teens and typically live for over half a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Advozsec's paranoid and pessimistic nature causes them to tend towards balanced alignments, particularly lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Advozsec typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 130 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your vision can easily cut through {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Horn
entries: Your sharp horn is a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Lava Dweller
entries: Your body is well accustomed to extreme heat, giving you {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to fire damage.

entries.name: Vigilant
entries: When you would roll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative}, you can choose to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. Once you've done so, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can do so again.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Advb. Advb sounds quick and aggressive. It's incredibly rare to find a non-advozsec speaking Advb, some linguists even considering it all but a dead language.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Aing-tii reach adulthood in their late teens and live more than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Aing-tii's foreign nature causes them to be hard to understand. Most aing-tii tend toward neutral light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Aing-tii typically stand 6 to 7 feet tall and generally weigh about 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Armored Plates
entries: You have thick armored plates. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Closed Mind
entries: Aing-tii have a natural attunement for the Force, which makes them resistant to its powers. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Force-Sensitive
entries: You know the {@i force push/pull} at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. Wisdom or Charisma (your choice) is your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for this power.

entries.name: Prehensile Tail
entries: You have supreme control over your tail and can use it to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

entries.name: Wisdom of the Elders
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can understand, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, and the non-verbal communication of the aing-tii. However, you cannot speak or make noise verbally.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Aleena reach adulthood in their late teens and live to be about 80.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Aleena's benevolent yet curious nature causes them to tend toward chaotic light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Aleena typically stand 2 and a half to 3 feet tall and generally weigh about 35 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Your sharp teeth are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage. Lastly, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can perform a special bite attack. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1), and you can't use this trait again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Cosmopolitan
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Nimble Escape
entries: You can take the Disengage or {@action Hide|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of its turns.

entries.name: Nimbleness
entries: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

entries.name: Racer's Reflexes
entries: Whenever you make a Dexterity {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can choose to add 1d4 to the result. You can choose to do this after the check is rolled, but before the DM determines if you've passed or failed the check. You cannot do so again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Aleena. Aleena is characterized by its use of short syllables and energetic movements to convey urgency and emotion.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Anomid reach adulthood in their late teens and live a little under a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Anomid's pacifistic culture causes them to tend toward light alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Anomid typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 120 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Agricultural Exports
entries: Whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}) or Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check related to food, agriculture, or agricultural technology, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the skill.

entries.name: Tech Dabbler
entries: You know the {@i minor hologram} at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i repair droid} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i hold droid} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for these powers.

entries.name: Tech Resistance
entries: Growing up around technology leaves an impact on anomid. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity and Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Tech Savant
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Vocalizer
entries: Anomid have no vocal cords, and rely on a vocalizer to communicate with other species. If your vocalizer is removed or destroyed, you cannot speak.

entries.name: Wealthy
entries: During character creation, you start with additional credits equal to your level x your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} x 1,000 cr.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} through the use of your vocalizer. You can also use Anomid Sign Language, which is an elaborate language requiring six-fingered hands.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Anx reach adulthood in their late teens and live up to 120 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: The anx's social nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Anx stand at around 8 feet tall and weigh about 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Acute Smell
entries: Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check involving smell, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Anatomical Knowledge
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Subsonic Bellow
entries: As an action, you can violently expel air in a 15-foot cone. When you do so, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Constitution modifier). A creature takes 2d6 sonic damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to 4d6 at 5th level, 6d6 at 11th level, and 8d6 at 17th level. This ability has no effect on constructs. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Surgical Strikes
entries: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage. Additionally, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can perform a special pressure point attack. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, and it must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Constitution modifier). On a failed save, the target is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the end of its next turn, and you can't use this feature again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Anx. Anx is mostly characterized by low, rumbling noises made by the throat, amplified by an anx's crest. Anx are able to communicate over long distances with each other by using loud low-frequency sounds.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Anzellans are considered adults at ten years old. They are a short-lived species, however, that rarely lives longer than 60 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Anzellans are a friendly and respectful people, which causes them to tend toward lawful light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Anzellans stand between 1 and 2 feet tall and weigh around 10 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Tiny.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 20 feet.

entries.name: Crafters
entries: You have proficiency in one tool of your choice.

entries.name: Detail Oriented
entries: You are {@feat Practiced|sw5e-phb|practiced} at scouring for details. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight within 5 feet.

entries.name: Pintsized
entries: Your tiny stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use medium or heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't wield weapons with the two-handed or versatile property, and you can only wield one-handed weapons in two hands unless they have the light property.

entries.name: Puny
entries: Anzellans are too small to pack much of a punch. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, and when determining your bonus to attack and damage rolls for weapon attacks using Strength, you can't add more than +3.

entries.name: Small and Nimble
entries: You are too small and fast to effectively target. You have a +1 bonus to AC, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

entries.name: Tanned
entries: You are naturally adapted to hot climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

entries.name: Technician
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Tinker
entries: You have proficiency with {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements}. You can use these and spend 1 hour and 100 cr worth of materials to construct a Tiny Device (AC 5, 1 hp). You can take the {@action Use an Object|sw5e-phb} action to have your device cause one of the following effects: create a small {@spell Explosion|sw5e-phb|explosion}, create a repeating loud noise for 1 minute, create smoke for 1 minute, create a soothing melody for 1 minute. You can maintain a number of these devices up to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} at once, and a device stops functioning after 24 hours away from you. You can dismantle the device to reclaim the materials used to create it.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Anzellan. Anzellan is characterized by its bouncy sound and emphasis on alternating syllables.

abilityEntry.name: Ability Score Increase:
abilityEntry.entry: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Aqualish reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Aqualish' aggressive personalities cause them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Aqualish stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 190 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Arms Dealers
entries: Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check related to buying or selling weapons, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Aggressive
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Menacing
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Aqualish. Aqualish is a harsh, guttural language. It's rare that other species bother to learn it unless they regularly interact with Aqualish.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Arcona reach adulthood in their late teens and live for more than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Arcona tend toward no particular alignment. They can vary from the chaotic thrillseekers to the orderly lawkeepers. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Arcona typically stand 5 and a half to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your sharp talons are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Clever
entries: You have proficiency in one Intelligence skill of your choice.

entries.name: Easily Addicted
entries: Arcona are susceptible to spice addiction, and as a result you are taught to identify it from an early age. Additionally, consuming salt can cause them to hallucinate, potentially replicating the effects of spice. Whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} related to identifying salt or spice or seeing whether something contains salt or spice, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, your thick hide is naturally adapted to hot climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve smell.

entries.name: Reptilian Senses
entries: Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check related to sensing heat, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Arconese. Arconese is spoken through complex, guttural squeaks from the back of the throat. However, arcona born and raised in colonies outside of Cona often did not learn Arconese, but the local language instead.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Ardennians reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Ardennians' peaceful nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Ardennians typically stand 4 to 4 and a half feet tall and weigh around 60 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Four-Armed
entries: Ardennians have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).

entries.name: Jungle Dweller
entries: Growing up in the tree-villages of Ardennia has left an impact. You don't treat jungle terrain as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}.

entries.name: Mask of the Wild
entries: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

entries.name: Prehensile Feet
entries: You have supreme control over your feet and can use them to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

entries.name: Strong-Legged
entries: When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Treeclimber
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Ardennian. Ardennian has a bubbly, energizing tone to it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Arkanians reach adulthood in their late teens and live about 100 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Due to their arrogance and unscrupulous experimentation, arkanians tend towards lawful dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Arkanians typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Arkanian Brilliance
entries: Whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Intelligence, you can choose to add 1d4 to the result. You can choose to do this after the check is rolled, but before the DM determines if you've passed or failed the check. You cannot do so again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Crafters
entries: You have proficiency in one tool of your choice.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Honed Mind
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against force and {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Infrared Sight
entries: Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check related to sight, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb|perceive} is in direct sunlight.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Arkanian. Arkanian, when spoken, has an airy tone, and is regarded as one of the most difficult written languages to learn.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Balosars reach adulthood in their late teens and live about 70 years naturally, though death stick addiction has lead to a general decline in their lifespan.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Balosars are notoriously cynical, selfish, and pragmatic, causing most to be neutral dark side. However, there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Balosar stand at an average height of about 5 feet, and weigh about 115 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Keen Hearing
entries: Your antennapalps give you {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks based on hearing.

entries.name: Snap Senses
entries: Through your antennapalps, you can sense incoming danger and react accordingly. When you roll for {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative}, you can choose to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. Alternatively, if you are surprised, you may act normally on your first turn. Once you've used this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Spicer
entries: You are proficient in spicer's kit.

entries.name: Toxin Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}, and you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage (explained in chapter 9).

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Balosur. Balosur is known by its throaty rasps and deep vocalizations, and is considered crude as a written language.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Barabel reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Barabel aggression causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Barabel typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh about 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, your thick hide is naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

entries.name: Hunter
entries: You are proficient in {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Prehensile Tail
entries: You have supreme control over your tail and can use it to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

entries.name: Tooth and Nail
entries: Your sharp teeth and claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage. Lastly, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can perform a special claw attack. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1), and you can't use this trait again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Barabel. The Barabel language is characterized by its barks and hisses.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Baragwin reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Baragwin tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Baragwin typically stand 5 to 7 feet tall and generally weigh about 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Arms Dealers
entries: Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check related to buying or selling weapons, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve smell.

entries.name: Natural Empathy
entries: Baragwin's powerful sense of smell allows them to sense the emotions in those around them. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks to determine emotions against humanoids and beasts within 10 feet of you.

entries.name: Travelers
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Weapon Developers
entries: Baragwin are famous throughout the galaxy for their quality arms manufacturing. You have proficiency with {@item Armstech's implements|sw5e-phb|armstech's implements}, munitions kits, or two weapons of your choice.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Baragwinian. Baragwinian is a deep language with low rumbling vocalizations. The baragwin themselves, however, are not especially fond of this language. Most of them learn the languages used on whatever planet they were born, so Baragwinian is not very common. Baragwinian is still considered useful as a trade language, however.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Besalisks reach adulthood in their early teens and generally live to be about 70.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Besalisks tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Besalisks tower over almost all other species, with the smallest standing at 6 feet tall and weighing 200 lbs., and the largest approaching 8 feet tall and 400 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Four-Armed
entries: Besalisks have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).

entries.name: Long-Limbed
entries: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Besalisk.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Caamasi reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Caamasi's peaceful and just nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Caamasi typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Call for Peace
entries: As an action on your turn, you can emphatically demand that your foes embrace peace, thereby distracting them. Until the end of your next turn, enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you gain {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against your allies. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Diplomatic
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Memnii Transfer
entries: As an action, while touching a creature, you can initiate a memnii transfer. The creature must make an Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Intelligence modifier), a creature can choose to fail this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} if it wishes. On a failed save the target is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned}, and you can share vivid memories with the target as if they were their own for 1 minute or until your {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} ends (as if you were concentrating on a power). The transfer ends if you stop touching the target. At the end of each of its turns, the creature can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist the transfer. On a success, the transfer ends. Otherwise, you may end the transfer on your turn (no action required). Once you've used this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. This feature has no effect on droids, constructs, or Force-Insensitive creatures.

entries.name: Scholarly
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Caamasi. Caamasi uses smooth tones and low volumes, making it soothing to listen to. Many popular nursery rhymes have been written in Caamasi to help children to sleep.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Chadra-Fan reach adulthood by 15 and live an average of 40 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Chadra-Fan's open, clan-based culture cause them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Chadra-Fan stand 3-4 feet tall and weigh about 45 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Climb
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing or smell.

entries.name: Second Heart
entries: When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Tinker
entries: You have proficiency with {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements}. You can use these and spend 1 hour and 100 cr worth of materials to construct a Tiny Device (AC 5, 1 hp). You can take the {@action Use an Object|sw5e-phb} action to have your device cause one of the following effects: create a small {@spell Explosion|sw5e-phb|explosion}, create a repeating loud noise for 1 minute, create smoke for 1 minute, emit an onerous smell for 1 minute. You can maintain a number of these devices up to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} at once, and a device stops functioning after 24 hours away from you. You can dismantle the device to reclaim the materials used to create it.

entries.name: Trance
entries: You only need 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it to gain its benefits.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Chadra-Fan. The Chadra-Fan language is characterized as being nasally and squeaky.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Chagrians reach adulthood in their late teens and live an average of 75 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Chagrians' peace-loving nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Chagrians typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Natural Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}, and you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage (explained in chapter 9).

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Chagri.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Chevin reach adulthood in their thirties and live up to 200 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Chevin warmongering and slavetrading cause them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Chevin stand between 6 and 8 feet tall and weigh up to 300 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, your thick hide is naturally adapted to both hot and cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

entries.name: Keen Hearing
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing.

entries.name: Nomadic
entries: You are proficient in {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Thick Skull
entries: Your skull is a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Chevin. The Chevin language is characterized by grunts and low-pitched rumblings. Chevin typically have deep voices, even when speaking Basic.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Chironians reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Chironians tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Chironians typically stand 6 to 8 feet tall and generally weigh about 600 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 40 feet.

entries.name: Cultured
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Equine Build
entries: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples. Additionally, any climb that requires hands and feet is especially difficult for you because of your hooves. When you make such a climb, each foot of movement costs you 4 extra feet, instead of the normal 1 extra foot. Finally, a Medium or smaller creature can ride on your equine back if you allow it. In such a situation, you continue to act independently, not as a controlled mount.

entries.name: Hooves and Horns
entries: Your hooves (and depending on your age, horns) are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Powerful Charge
entries: If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line before hitting with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can attempt to trip the target prone as part of the same attack. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Chironan. Chironan is characterized by its soft, melodic sounds.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Clawdites reach adulthood in their early teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Clawdites' pragmatism cause them to tend towards neutral balanced, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Clawdites typically stand 5 to 7 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Changeling Instincts
entries: You gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries: As an action, you can change your appearance and your voice. You determine the specifics of the changes, including your coloration, hair length, and sex. You can also adjust your height and weight, but not so much that your size changes. You can make yourself appear as a member of another species, though none of your game statistics change. You can't duplicate the appearance of a creature you've never seen, and you must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs that you have. Your clothing and equipment aren't changed by this trait. You stay in the new form until you use an action to revert to your true form or until you die.

entries.name: Unsettling Visage
entries: When a creature you can see makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the roll. You must use this feature before knowing whether the attack hits or misses. Using this trait reveals your shapeshifting nature to any creature within 30 feet that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, Clawdite, and one more language of your choice. Clawdite is characterized by its rolling sounds paired with hissing sibilants.

abilityEntry.name: Ability Score Increase:
abilityEntry.entry: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Codru-Ji reach adulthood in their early teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Steeped in selfish tradition, Codru-Ji tend towards the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Codru-Ji stand 5 to 6 feet tall and weigh around 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Four-Armed
entries: Codru-Ji have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Keen Hearing
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing.

entries.name: Natural Grappler
entries: Whenever you make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check to grapple you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Trance
entries: You only need 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it to gain its benefits.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Codruese, which has a solemn and stately cadence to it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Strength or Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Colicoids reach adulthood by 8 and live to be about 65.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Colicoid's emotionless nature causes them to tend towards balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Colicoids typically stand 6 to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Acute Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Cannibalize
entries: If you spend at least 1 minute devouring the corpse of a beast or humanoid, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of one). Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Closed Mind
entries: Colicoid brains have an unusual composition which gives them a natural defense against the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Defensive Ball
entries: You are able to curl into a rolling ball for extra protection. When you take the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb} action while you aren't wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}, you gain a bonus to AC equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: Due to your carapace and the shape of your body, you are ill-suited to wearing armor. Your carapace provides ample protection, however; it gives you a base AC of 17 (your Dexterity modifier doesn't affect this number). You gain no benefit from wearing armor, but if you are using a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}, you can apply the {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}'s bonus as normal.

entries.name: Stinger
entries: Your stinger is a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Colicoid. The Colicoid language uses sounds produced by the antennae and jointed legs of the colicoids, including humming sounds and clicks, which makes it difficult for other species to speak.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Culisetto reach adulthood at 8 years old, and live to be about 60.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Culisettos' thirst for blood cause them to tend towards the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Culisetto stand between 3 and 4 feet tall and weigh about 45 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Cannibalize
entries: If you spend at least 1 minute devouring the corpse of a beast or humanoid, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Climb
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet.

entries.name: Compound Eyes
entries: Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check related to sight, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Powerful Leap
entries: If you jump at least 10 feet in a straight line before hitting with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can attempt to trip the target as part of the same attack. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Prehensile Feet
entries: You have supreme control over your feet and can use them to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

entries.name: Strong-Legged
entries: When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

entries.name: Torpor
entries: You only need 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it to gain its benefits.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields} or {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Culisetto. Culisetto is composed of high pitched whines made from the snout.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Dashade reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Dashade's aggressive yet loyal nature causes them to tend toward lawful dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Dashade typically stand 5 and a half to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh around 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Force Contention
entries: Due to their unique physiology, dashade hardiness allows them to overcome use of the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength and Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Heat Dissipation
entries: Whenever you make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) check to avoid detection by electronic sensors and cameras, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Menacing
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Radiation Resistant
entries: Dashade are naturally able to resist {@spell Radiation|sw5e-phb|radiation}. You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to necrotic damage.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Dashadi. Dashadi is characterized by its low pitch and elongated growls.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Defel reach adulthood in their early teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Defel tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Defel typically stand 4 to 5 feet tall and generally weigh around 100 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your claws are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Hidden Step
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can turn {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} until the start of your next turn or until you attack, make a damage roll, or force someone to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Once you've used this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Miners
entries: You have proficiency in scavenging kits.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb|perceive} is in direct sunlight.

entries.name: Sneaky
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Defel. Most defel refuse to speak {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} while on their home planet of Af'El unless they have a specific need for it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Diathim reach adulthood in their late teens and live about 100 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Diathim are naturally empathetic, causing them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Diathim typically stand 6 to 9 feet tall and generally weigh about 100 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Type
entries: Your creature type is both aberration and humanoid.

entries.name: Celestial Physiology
entries: You can {@optfeature Survive|sw5e-phb|survive} for one day within the vacuum of space.

entries.name: Enthralling Hypnosis
entries: You can use your psychic aura to influence individuals of both sexes. Whenever you roll a 1 on a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. Additionally, once per short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can treat a {@dice d20} roll of 9 or lower on a Charisma check as a 10. This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: Flight
entries: You have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. While wearing medium or {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, your flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced by half.

entries.name: Fragile
entries: Diathim are too weak to pack much of a punch. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, and when determining your bonus to attack and damage rolls for weapon attacks using Strength, you can't add more than +3.

entries.name: Luminescent Aura
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to amplify your radiant aura, causing a searing light to radiate from you. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. During it, you shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet, and at the end of each of your turns, you and each creature within 10 feet of you take psychic damage equal to half your level (rounded up). In addition, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra psychic damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a power. The extra psychic damage equals your level.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one extra language of your choice.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Dowutins are considered a child until around the age of 75 in which they are a full fledged adult. Dowutins can live upwards of 900 years with even more ancient ones exceeding that.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Dowutins are aggressive and brash, causing them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Dowutins have a unique special characteristic; from birth to death, they never stop growing. Even as an adolescent, dowutins tend to tower over other species, reaching heights over 8 feet and weighing 400 pounds. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme cold.

entries.name: Hunter
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing or smell.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Dowuta. Dowuta consists of deep, booming vocalizations and is considered difficult for members of other species to emulate.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Draethos reach adulthood around their late teens and live up to 800 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Draethos tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Draethos typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 190 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Telepathy
entries: You can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet of you. You must share a language with the target in order to communicate in this way.

entries.name: Way of the Warrior
entries: You have proficiency with light and {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor} as well as vibroblades and vibroswords.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Draethos. Draethos is characterized by its flurry of cacophonous sighs and clicks.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Dugs reach adulthood in their early teens and live an average of 75 years. Their violent nature often leads to violent ends.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Dugs' angry nature causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Dugs typically stand between 3 and 4 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Courageous
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened}.

entries.name: Fisticuffs
entries: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Fury of the Small
entries: When you damage a creature with an attack or a power and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or power to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Menacing
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Strong and Small
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Dug.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Echani reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Echani culture's emphasis on honor and combat cause them to tend towards lawful alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Echani stand between 5 and a half and 6 feet tall and weigh around 150 lbs, with little variation between them. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Allies of the Force
entries: Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check against someone you know to wield the Force, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Unarmed Combatant
entries: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Echani Art
entries: If a humanoid you can see makes a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check against the target's Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}). On a success you learn one of the following traits about that creature: it's Strength, Dexterity or Constitution score; bonus to Strength, Dexterity or Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}; {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class}; or current {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. On a failure, the target becomes immune to this feature for one day. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses on a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Combative Culture
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Martial Upbringing
entries: You have proficiency in {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, and gain proficiency with two martial {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} of your choice.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one extra language of your choice.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength or Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Esh-kha reach adulthood in their early teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: The esh-kha's stubborn and racially-centric mindsets cause them to tend toward lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Esh-kha typically stand 6 to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Force-Sensitive
entries: You know your choice of the {@i turbulence}, {@i force disarm}, or {@i slow} at-will {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Wisdom or Charisma (depending on power alignment).

entries.name: Inquisitive
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Savage Attacks
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit}.

entries.name: Skill Versatility
entries: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

entries.name: Weapon Training
entries: You have proficiency in two {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} or {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} of your choice.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kharan. Kharan contains many metaphorical expressions when translated to {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}. The language has many comparisons to music and singing, such as a galactic government being compared to a chorus.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Falleen reach adulthood in their late teens and live up to 250 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Falleen societal structure causes them to tend to be lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Falleen typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh around 165 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Closed Mind
entries: Falleen brains have an unusual composition which make them resistant to influence from the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Enthralling Pheromones
entries: You can use your pheromones to influence individuals of both sexes. Whenever you roll a 1 on a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. Additionally, once per short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can treat a {@dice d20} roll of 9 or lower on a Charisma check as a 10. This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour at a time.

entries.name: Mask of the Wild
entries: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Falleen. Falleen is characterized by its common use of the Z and X sounds, of which the Falleen are fond.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Felucians reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Felucians' connection to the Living Force causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Felucians typically stand over 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Force-Sensitive
entries: You know the {@i burst} at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i beast trick} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i plant surge} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. Wisdom is your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for these powers.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Stealthy
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Mask of the Wild
entries: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, Felucianese, and one more language of your choice. Felucianese is characterized by guttural, whisper-like vowels, interspersed with hard clicks.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Wisdom or Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Flesh raiders reach adulthoood by 20 and rarely live longer than 90 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Flesh raiders' propensity towards war and aggression cause them to tend toward chaotic dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Flesh raiders typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Aggressive
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

entries.name: Cannibalize
entries: If you spend at least 1 minute devouring the corpse of a beast or humanoid, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of one). Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Force Contention
