entries: Due to their unique physiology, flesh raider hardiness allows them to overcome use of the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength and Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Menacing
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Hunters
entries: Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) check to hunt for food, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Rakata. Rakata is characterized by its deep tones and simplistic nature, using mainly consonants and long vowels. It's script seems to be a very ancient form of {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Gand reach adulthood when they earn their name, which is usually in their teens, and live to be about 70 on average.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Gand tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Gand stand 4 to 6 feet tall and weigh around 100 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Exoskeleton
entries: You have a thick exoskeleton. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Gand Resilience
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}, and you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage (explained in chapter 9).

entries.name: Lungless
entries: Gand do not have lungs, and therefore do not need to breathe.

entries.name: Regenerative
entries: When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a Hit Die to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} as long as the damage would not reduce your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to 0.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Gand. The Gand language does not use pronouns as Gand refer to themselves in the third person, so often Gand who speak {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} are difficult to understand.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Dexterity or Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Ganks reach adulthood in their late teens and live for slightly more than a century thanks to their cybernetics.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Ganks aggressive and hair trigger nature causes them to tend towards chaotic dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Ganks typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 35 feet. You ignore the strength property of {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}.

entries.name: Aggressive
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

entries.name: Athletic
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Gank Training
entries: You have proficiency in light and {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor} as well as two {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} or {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} of your choice.

entries.name: Mercenary Specialization
entries: You have proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Gank. You can communicate with other ganks within 30 feet without speaking through use of cybernetic implants. Tech casters can detect the communication but can't understand it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: You Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Constitution or Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Geonosians reach adulthood at 10 and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Geonosians' greedy and self-serving nature causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Geonosians typically stand from 5 to 6 feet tall and rarely weigh more than 80 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Crafter
entries: Geonosian culture promotes artisanry. You have proficiency in one set of artisan's implements of your choice.

entries.name: Exoskeleton
entries: You have a thick exoskeleton. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Flight
entries: You have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. While wearing medium or {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, your flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced by half.

entries.name: Geonosian Weaponry
entries: You have proficiency in {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} that deal sonic damage.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Geonosian. The Geonosian language consists of click consonants through use of a Geonosians' dual mandibles. This makes it difficult for other species to learn to speak it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Givin reach adulthood in their early teens and live about 80 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Givins believe power and respect are earned rather than expected, causing them to tend towards balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Givin typically stand around 6 feet tall and weigh 150 lb. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Hardened Exterior
entries: You have a tough, bony exterior. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Mathematical Savants
entries: Whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check involving mathematics, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Stargazer
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Vacuum Sealed
entries: You can {@optfeature Survive|sw5e-phb|survive} for one day within the vacuum of space. You still require oxygen to breathe. You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to cold damage.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Givin. Givin is characterized by its use of mathematical jargon and symbols, making it nigh incomprehensible to the less mathematically inclined.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Gormaks reach adulthood in their late teens and live for more than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Gormaks' warlike nature causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Gormaks typically stand 5 and a half to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Adaptive Resilience
entries: Their innate understanding of technology allow gormak to readily adapt to its effects. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength and Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Aggressive
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Technological Affinity
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill, one {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} and one {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} of your choice, and your choice of {@item Armstech's implements|sw5e-phb|armstech's implements}, {@item Biotech's implements|sw5e-phb|biotech's implements}, constructor's implements, mechanic's kits, or {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements}. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) checks made to understand, utilize, or modify technology that you are unaware of or have never seen before.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Gormak. Gormak is primitive and gruff, often lacking definitions for things found outside of their homeworld.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Gotals reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Gotals' polite and respectful nature causes them to tend toward lawful alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Gotals typically stand 6 to 7 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Energy Sensors
entries: Gotals {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb|perceive} the environment around them through use of electromagnetic sensors held in their cranial horns. You have {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight} out to 30 feet. If another trait would grant you {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight}, the range is increased by half as many feet.

entries.name: Hunter
entries: You are proficient in {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Natural Empathy
entries: Gotal's electromagnetic sensors allow them to sense the emotions in those around them. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks to determine emotions against humanoids and beasts within 10 feet of you.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Antarian. The Antarian language is characterized by growls and clicking noises at various volumes.

abilityEntry.name: Ability Score Increase:
abilityEntry.entry: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Gran reach adulthood around their late teens and live up to 80 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Gran highly organized society cause them to tend toward lawful alignments, though there are exceptions..

entries.name: Size
entries: Gran typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh around 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Slow Metabolism
entries: You are able to go a number of days without food equal to 3 + twice your Constitution modifier before suffering {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}.

entries.name: Keen Sight
entries: Through use of infrared vision, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Reader of Hearts
entries: Through identifying subtle variations in a target's body heat, the Gran are able to better understand their emotions and intentions. You are proficient in the {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Toughness
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Gran. It is rare to hear Gran spoken on any world other than Kinyen.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Half-humans gain the ability score increases of their non-human half, but they can choose any ability score for one of the options, instead of the given option. Half-humans can not increase the same ability score twice during character creation using this feature.

entries.name: Age
entries: Half-humans live around the average of the two species' lifespans.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Half-humans tend towards their non-human half's alignment.

entries.name: Size
entries: Half-humans stand and weigh around the average of the two species' height and weight. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is the size of your non-human half.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is that of your non-human half.

entries.name: Defiant
entries: Half-humans are known to be stubborn and often refuse to give up, even against the worst odds. When you or a creature you can see that can see and understand you makes an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can roll a {@dice d4} and add it to their roll (no action required). You can use this before or after the roll, but before the GM determines the roll's outcome. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, regardless of whether or not the non-human half can speak it, and the language(s) associated with your non-human half.

abilityEntry.name: Ability Score Increase:
abilityEntry.entry: Half-humans gain the ability score increases of their non-human half, but they can choose any ability score for one of the options, instead of the given option. Half-humans can not increase the same ability score twice during character creation using this feature.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength, Constitution, and Intelligence scores increase by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Harch reach adulthood at age 10 and can live up to 200 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Harch are cold, calculating beings, causing them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Harch stand around 6 feet tall and weigh between 200 and 300 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Your fangs are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage. Lastly, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can perform a special bite attack. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, and it must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Constitution modifier). On a failed save, the target is {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} until the end of its next turn, and you can't use this feature again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Six-Armed
entries: Harch have six arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing, and while climbing you always have two hands free.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Harchese. Harchese is discernible from other insectoid languages by a noticeable emphasis on consonants, especially the "ch" sound.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Herglic reach adulthood in their late teens and live up to 120 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Herglics' gentle nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Herglic stand between 6 and 8 feet tall and weigh up to 600 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour at a time.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Technician
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Toughness
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Herglese. Herglese has a clear and commanding cadence, drawing the attention of those who hear it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Ho'din reach adulthood in their early 30s and live up to 120 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Ho'dins' benevolent nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Ho'din are taller than most species, typically standing 8 to 10 feet tall and generally weighing about 275 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Biological Specialists
entries: You have proficiency with {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

entries.name: Cold Sensitivity
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme cold.

entries.name: Crafters
entries: You have proficiency with one artisan's implements of your choice.

entries.name: Naturalist
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Rain Forest Dweller
entries: Growing up in the rain forests of Moltok has left an impact. You don't treat forest terrain as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}.

entries.name: Reptilian Senses
entries: Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check related to sensing heat, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Second Heart
entries: When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Treeclimber
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, and Ho'Din. Ho'Din consists of croaks and hisses. Its written form includes characters derived from the shapes of Moltok flora. The Ho'Din lexicon includes a great amount of plant-based idioms and metaphors.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Houk reach adulthood in their late teens and live for about 80 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Most houk are short-tempered and deceitful, causing them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Houk typically stand 6 to 8 feet tall and generally weigh about 300 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Ambusher
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

entries.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

entries.name: Toughness
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Houkese. Houkese is mainly formed by grunts, with subtle tonal inflections to differentiate words that would otherwise sound the same. Written Houkese uses primitive ideograms with one letter to represent each simple verb, and complex pictograms to represent nouns.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Hutts are considered a child until around the age of 200 in which they are a full fledged adult.  Hutts can live upwards of 900 years with even more ancient ones exceeding that.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Hutts are selfish, greedy, and highly organized, causing them to tend toward chaotic dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Hutts have a unique special characteristic; from birth to death, they never stop growing. As an adolescent hutt, you typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh at least 400 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 20 feet.

entries.name: Closed Mind
entries: Hutt brains have an unusual composition which made them resistant to influence from the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Natural Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}, and you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage (explained in chapter 9).

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

entries.name: Prehensile Tail
entries: You have supreme control over your tail and can use it to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

entries.name: Shrewd Demeanor
entries: You have proficiency in two Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma skills of your choice.

entries.name: Slow and Lethargic
entries: Hutts are slow and generally incapable of moving quickly. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, and when determining your bonus to AC from your Dexterity, you can't add more than +3.

entries.name: Wealthy
entries: During character creation, you start with additional credits equal to your level x your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} x 1,000 cr.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and {@language Huttese|sw5e-phb|Huttese}. Hutts rarely speak {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, even though they are perfectly able; if the person with whom they are speaking doesn't understand {@language Huttese|sw5e-phb|Huttese}, they are more likely to use an interpretor than deign to speak the language of lesser species.

abilityEntry.name: Ability Score Increase:
abilityEntry.entry: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Iktotchi reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Iktotchi are lawful and tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Iktotchi typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh about 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Precognition
entries: You can see brief fragments of the future, that allow you to turn failures into successes. When you roll a 1 on an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

entries.name: Telepathy
entries: You can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet of you. You must share a language with the target in order to communicate in this way.

entries.name: Horns
entries: Your horns are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Pilot
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Iktotchese.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Kage reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Kages' rigid sense of honor causes them to tend toward lawful light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Kage typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall, and weigh around 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Animal Handler
entries: You are proficient in {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Athletic
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Strong-Legged
entries: When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb|perceive} is in direct sunlight.

entries.name: Superior Darkvision
entries: You've lived most of your life without direct sunlight. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Unarmed Combatant
entries: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Weapon Training
entries: Kage are adept warriors. You are proficient with the electroprod and electrostaff.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one language of your choice.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Kaleesh reach adulthood in their early teens and live to be about 80.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Kaleesh tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Kaleesh typically stand about five and a half feet tall and weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: The thermal pits under a Kaleesh's eyes grant {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Weapon Training
entries: Kaleesh are adept hunters. You are proficient with the {@item Blaster carbine|sw5e-phb|blaster carbine}, {@item Vibroblade|sw5e-phb|vibroblade}, {@item Vibropike|sw5e-phb|vibropike}, and, {@item Vibrospear|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Tracker
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill. Additionally, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) checks made to track a creature if that creature has a scent.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kaleesh.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Kallerans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Kallerans' individualistic society causes them to tend towards chaotic alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Kallerans typically stand 6 and a half to 8 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Flexible
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve flexibility.

entries.name: Keen Hearing
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing.

entries.name: Prehensile Feet
entries: You have supreme control over your feet and can use them to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

entries.name: Snap Senses
entries: Through your antenna, you can sense incoming danger and react accordingly. When you roll for {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative}, you can choose to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. Alternatively, if you are surprised, you may act normally on your first turn. Once you've used this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kall. Kall depends upon distinct antenna movements communicate correctly. This leads to this characteristic antenna movement when kallerans speak {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}. Because antenna movement is an integral part of Kall, it is difficult for most other species to master.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2 and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Kaminoans reach adulthood at 11 years old and live around 100 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Kaminoans highly organized society lead individuals to tend toward a lawful alignment, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Kaminoans typically stand 7 to 8 feet tall and weigh around 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Geneticist
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Long-Limbed
entries: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

entries.name: Tech Dabbler
entries: You know the {@i temporary boost} at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You do not require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for this power.

entries.name: Ultraviolet Sight
entries: Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check related to sight, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kaminoan. Kaminoan is characterized by its flowing water-like sound.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Kakarodon reach adulthood in their early teens and live to be about 70.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Karkarodons' warmongering nature causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions

entries.name: Size
entries: Karkarodons stand 5 to 7 feet tall and weigh upwards of 250 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Aggressive
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Your sharp teeth are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage. Lastly, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can perform a special bite attack. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1), and you can't use this trait again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Karkaran. Karkaran is characterized by its fierce sounds.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength or Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom or Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Kiffar reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Kiffar are independent and free spirited, causing them to tend towards chaotic alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Kiffar vary widely in height and build, from barely 5 feet to well over 6 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Iron Will
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed}.

entries.name: Nimble Reflexes
entries: Kiffar are naturally adapted to avoiding the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity and Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Tribal Warrior
entries: You have proficiency with two {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} of your choice.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one extra language of your choice. Kiffar never had a tongue to call their own, using {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} as far back as their history goes.

entries.name: Kiffar Heritage
entries: A small percentage of the kiffar population are naturally {@feat Force-Sensitive|sw5e-phb|Force-sensitive}, able to read the memories contained within inanimate objects, while others train to become proud guardians of their home sector. You choose one of the following heritages:

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Killiks reach adulthood in their 40s and live an average of 200 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Killiks' willingness to brainwash or kill their enemies cause them to tend towards the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Killiks stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh about 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Four-Armed
entries: Killiks have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).

entries.name: Hardened Carapace
entries: While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Strong-Legged
entries: When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Telepathy
entries: You can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet of you. You must share a language with the target in order to communicate in this way.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Killik. You can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength, Constitution, and Wisdom scores increase by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Klatooinians reach adulthood in their late teens and can live as long as 90 standard years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Klatooinian society encourages reverence for tradition and an inclination towards violence, causing them to tend toward lawful dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Klatooinians typically stand around 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Enforcer
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill. When you take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action to give an ally {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on an {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} check, they gain a bonus to the roll equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Toughness
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

entries.name: Weapon Training
entries: Klatooinians are trained to fight from a young age. You have proficiency in two martial {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} of your choice.

entries.name: Wisdom of the Elders
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, Klatooinian, and {@language Huttese|sw5e-phb|Huttese}. Klatooinian is a gutteral, barking language, with many loanwords adopted from {@language Huttese|sw5e-phb|Huttese} over the centuries.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Kubaz reach adulthood in their early teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Kubaz' courteous nature causes them to tend toward lawful alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Kubaz typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and weigh around 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Art Obsession
entries: Whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} related to the acquisition or location of art or valuables, you are considered proficient in the check. If you would already be proficient, you instead have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Deft Hand
entries: You have proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}, Sleight of Hand, or {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Slicer
entries: You have proficiency with the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill and the {@item Slicer's kit|sw5e-phb|slicer's kit}.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb|perceive} is in direct sunlight.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kubazian. Kubazian is comprised of a unique series of whirring, nasally syllables, causing Kubaz to have a high-pitched accent when speaking other languages.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Kushibans reach adulthood at 13 and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Kushibans' playful nature causes them to tend toward chaotic light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Kushibans typically stand 3 and a half to 4 feet tall and weigh around 40 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
entries: As an action on your turn, you can cower pathetically to distract nearby foes. Until the end of your next turn, your allies gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, your thick hide is naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

entries.name: Mask of the Wild
entries: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

entries.name: Nimble Agility
entries: Your reflexes and agility allow you to move with a burst of {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} until the end of the turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

entries.name: Stealthy
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kushiban. Kushiban has a bubbly, joyful tone to it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Kyuzo reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Kyuzos' belief in justice and honor cause them to tend toward lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Kyuzo typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 170 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your natural evolution allows you to see what others do not in dim and dark conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Foreign Biology
entries: Kyuzo struggle in atmospheres other than those of Phatrong. You wear a filter mask, and if your mask is removed while you are in such an environment, you lose consciousness.

entries.name: Long-Limbed
entries: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

entries.name: Strong-Legged
entries: When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Kyuzo. Kyuzo is characterized by short words and quick phrases. Kyuzo struggle with {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} as it is grammatically dissimilar to Kyuzo.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Lanniks reach adulthood in their 100's and can live up to 900 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Despite the {@spell Turbulence|sw5e-phb|turbulence} on their homeworld, Lanniks tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Lanniks typically stand 3 to 4 feet tall and rarely weigh more than 50 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Closed Mind
entries: Lanniks have a natural attunement for the Force, which makes them resistant to its powers. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Force-Sensitive
entries: You know the {@i guidance} at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i valor} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i force enlightenment} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. Wisdom is your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for these powers.

entries.name: Keen Hearing
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Wisdom of the Elders
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Lannik. Due to their large ears, the Lannik language is spoken softly, and it is considered insulting to shout.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Lasats reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Lasat' honorable tendences cause them to tend toward lawful light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Lasats tower over other species, averaging 7 feet tall and weighing over 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Bo-rifle Training
entries: You have proficiency with {@item Blaster rifle|sw5e-phb|blaster rifles}, bo-rifles, and vibrostaffs.

entries.name: Climbing
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your vision can easily cut through {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Lasat, a language whose {@i r}'s are difficult to replicate by most other species.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Lurmen reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than 80 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: The pacifistic nature of the lurmen causes them to be neutral light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Lurmen typically stand around 3 feet tall and generally weigh about 45 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Natural Healer
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} skills, and the bioanalysis kit.

entries.name: Prehensile Tail and Feet
entries: You have supreme control over your tail and feet and can use them to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

entries.name: Rolling Agility
entries: As a lurmen, you can run on all fours, or curl into a ball, to move quickly along the ground. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} until the end of the turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

entries.name: Treeclimber
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Lurmese. Lurmese is a name collectively given to the various tribal languages spoken by the lurmen people. While each language is distinct, shared phrases allow translation between dialects.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution increases by 2, and your Strength increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Massassi live relatively short lives. They reach adulthood after 14 years, and reach old age around 40 years of life.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: The massassi are savage and brutish warriors who relish on the violence of combat, usually following a dark and chaotic nature.

entries.name: Size
entries: Massassi are between 7 and 8 feet tall and weigh between 200 and 300 pounds. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Type
entries: Your creature type is both aberration and humanoid.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your vision can easily cut through {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Force Symbiosis
entries: When you reach 3rd level, you can cast your choice of the {@i curse}, {@i dun moch}, or {@i hex} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Charisma.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Oversized
entries: Lightweapons and {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} that lack the dexterity or light property are considered to have the heavy property for you. The strength number for {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true} is reduced by one step (from 19 to 17, 17 to 15, 15 to 13, or 13 to 11). If the strength number is 11, you ignore it entirely.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Sith. Sith is an agglutinative language, in which words or even phrases were made up of linear sequences of distinct meaningful units.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Mikkian reach adulthood in their late teens and live a little over a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Mikkian's honor and integrity based culture causes them to tend toward lawful alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Mikkian typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 120 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Blindsight
entries: Mikkian can {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb|perceive} the world around them through heat and {@spell Radiation|sw5e-phb|radiation}. You have {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight} out to 30 feet. If another trait would grant you {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight}, the range is increased by half as many feet.

entries.name: Keen Hearing
entries: Your head-tendrils provide a keen awareness of your surroundings. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing.

entries.name: Bureaucratic
entries: You have proficiency with {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Mikkian. Mikkian is a melodic, flowing tongue made up of several ancient dialects.

abilityEntry.name: Ability Score Increase:
abilityEntry.entry: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Miraluka reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Miraluka believe in balance and thus tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Miraluka typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Force-Sensitive
entries: You know the {@i mind trick} at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i sanctuary} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i force confusion} power once per day. Wisdom or Charisma (your choice) is your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for these powers.

entries.name: Force Sight
entries: Miraluka {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb|perceive} the environment around them through use of the Force. You are constantly under the effects of the {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} {@i force sight}, though the power does not require {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} for you.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Miralukese.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Mirialan reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Mirialans spiritual tendencies cause them to tend towards the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Mirialan typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and weight 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 35 feet.

entries.name: Spiritual
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}. Additionally, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in Intelligence ({@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}) checks made to learn or recall something about a culture's religion.

entries.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

entries.name: Unarmed Combatant
entries: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Mirialan.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Strength or Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Mustafarians reach adulthood in their late teens and live about 80 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Mustafarians are usually judicious and value good work above all else, causing them to be lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Mustafarians stand between 5 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 165 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet. You ignore the strength property of {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: As an originally cave-dwelling species, your eyes are adapted to the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Lava Dweller
entries: Your body is well accustomed to extreme heat, giving you {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to fire damage. Additionally, your thick hide is naturally adapted to hot climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

entries.name: Refinery Specialist
entries: You have proficiency in your choice of constructor's implements, scavenging kit, or surveyor's implements. Additionally, whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}) check to identify a metal or mineral, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Mustafarian. Mustafarian consists of choppy clicks and emphatic groans.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Muuns reach adulthood in their late teens and live an average of a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Muuns' lawful culture nature causes them to tend toward lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Muuns typically stand 6 and a half to 7 feet tall and weigh around 200 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Finance Savvy
entries: Muun share a keen business sense and an ability to find value where others don't. Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check involving finances you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Long-Limbed
entries: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

entries.name: Three Hearts
entries: When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Muun. The Muuns' admiration of mathematics carries over into their language, which bares a striking resemblance to {@language Binary|sw5e-phb|Binary}.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Neimoidians reach adulthood in their 20s and live about 150 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Neimoidians' greedy nature causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Neimoidians typically stand around 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 135 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
entries: As an action on your turn, you can cower pathetically to distract nearby foes. Until the end of your next turn, your allies gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Smooth Talker
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Wealthy
entries: During character creation, you start with additional credits equal to your level x your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} x 1,000 cr.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Pak Pak. Pak Pak is often considered an elegant-sounding language by those who hear it. It consists of husky sighs and guttural ululations.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Nikto reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Nikto's self-sufficient and clever nature causes them to tend toward balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Nikto typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Protective Membrane
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded}.

entries.name: Radiation Resistant
entries: The dying star nearby their homeworld makes nikto naturally used to {@spell Radiation|sw5e-phb|radiation}. You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to necrotic damage.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, Nikto, and {@language Huttese|sw5e-phb|Huttese}. Nikto is spoken with sharp syllables with a deep and rumbling cadence.

entries.name: Adaptation
entries: The frequent {@spell Radiation|sw5e-phb|radiation} bursts from the nearby dying star caused the nikto to mutate and adapt into different subspecies over time, specialized for different environments. Choose one of the following adaptations:

abilityEntry.name: Ability Score Increase:
abilityEntry.entry: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Noghri reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Noghri's honorable society causes them to tend toward a lawful alignment, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Noghri typically stand about 5 feet tall and weigh around 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Hunter
entries: You are proficient in {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Powerful Leap
entries: If you jump at least 10 feet in a straight line before hitting with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can attempt to trip the target prone as part of the same attack. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Strong-Legged
entries: When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Unarmed Combatant
entries: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Honorghran. Honorghran is characterized by its scratchy, gutteral sounds.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Nothoiin reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Nothoiins tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Nothoiins typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Born Pilots
entries: Nothoiins demonstrate seemingly innate piloting abilities from a very young age.  You have proficiency in the {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Expert Navigators
entries: You are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) checks made to navigate.

entries.name: Galactic Traveler
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Heightened Reflexes
entries: Whenever you make a Dexterity {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can choose to add 1d4 to the result. You can use this before or after the roll, but before the GM determines the roll's outcome. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Major Miners
entries: Nothoiins have intimate knowledge of ur-diamond mining and refinement practices.  You gain proficiency in your choice of jeweler's implements, scavenging kit, or archaeologist kit.

entries.name: Starship Specialists
entries: Whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check related to starships, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one language of your choice. You can also communicate via Notho, a native hand language developed by hunters living in the Nothoiin plains.  Usage of Notho is exceedingly rare outside Nothoiin culture.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Ortolans are considered adults at the age of seven and typically live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Ortolans' love of food and music causes them to tend toward chaotic light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Ortolans stand around 3 to 4 feet tall and weigh about 55 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Foragers
entries: Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) check to forage for food you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
entries: As an action on your turn, you can cower pathetically to distract nearby foes. Until the end of your next turn, your allies gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against enemies within 10 feet of you that can see you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Hide
entries: Your thick hide is naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing or smell.

entries.name: Musical
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb} and one musical instrument of your choice.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Ortolan. Ortolan is characterized by its grunts and hoots.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Pa'lowick reach adulthood in their late teens and live about 75 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Pa'lowick enjoy a raucous good time, causing them to tend toward chaotic light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Pa'lowick stand about 5 feet tall, and weigh approximately 100 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries: Pa'lowick have a great lung capacity and can hold their breath for up to 15 minutes at a time.

entries.name: Proud Performer
entries: Pa'lowick are best known for the energy they can bring to a singing performance. Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}) check involving singing, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Snout
entries: You have supreme control over your snout and can use it to manipulate objects as well as your hands. Additionally, your snout is a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Sonic Scream
entries: As an action, you can violently expel air in a 15-foot cone. When you do so, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Constitution modifier). A creature takes 2d6 sonic damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to 4d6 at 5th level, 6d6 at 11th level, and 8d6 at 17th level. This ability has no effect on constructs. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Swim
