entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Lowickese. Lowickese requires the user to purse their lips and blow air, and is considered amusing by other species.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Intelligence or Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Pantorans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Pantorans' interest in politics causes them to tend towards lawful alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Pantorans typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Cold Adaptation
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme cold.

entries.name: Cultured
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Impose Order
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can command each ally within 15 feet of you to move up to half that ally's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Negotiators
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) checks meant to negotiate terms or agreements between parties.

entries.name: Organized
entries: Your society values organization, and as such you are good at making good use of the space provided. When you are in {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} of packing a space, such as a vehicle or cargo hold, that space's carrying capacity is increased by one-fourth its base capacity.

entries.name: Political Guile
entries: You are proficient in {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Pantoran. Pantoran comprises many dialects that prevent clear communication, a vestige of the feudal culture of the planet's past. Because of the difficulties of operating a planetary government with so many different languages, the Assembly established {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} as the official language of their people as a means of unifying the planet.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Dexterity or Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Patrolians reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Patrolians' greedy, scheming nature causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Patrolians typically stand just over 3 feet tall and generally weigh about 40 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Conniving
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to life underwater, you have superior vision in low light conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Electrical Resistance
entries: Patrolians are notably capable of shrugging off electricity. You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to lightning damage.

entries.name: Specialist
entries: You have proficiency in one {@feat Specialist|sw5e-phb|specialist}'s kit of your choice.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet.

entries.name: Technician
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Patrolian. Patrolian is a high-energy language, consisting mostly of gurgles and skittish vocalizations. Patrolian, even when spoken on land, sounds like it's being spoken underwater.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Pau'ans reach adulthood in their 30's and have been known to live up to 700 years old.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Pau'ans' commanding presence, yet friendly and kind nature, cause them to tend to be lawful light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Pau'ans typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Authoritative
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

entries.name: Cultured
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Hypersensitive Hearing
entries: Pau'ans possess incredibly receptive hearing, often to their detriment, so you wear special covers on your ears. Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check involving hearing, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill, but if your hearing aids are removed, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal sonic damage.

entries.name: Vigilant
entries: You can choose to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on your next {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb} check. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Utapese. Utapese is characterized by its rigid, yet melodic sound.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Pykes reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Due to their underhanded nature, Pykes tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Pykes typically stand 6 to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 155 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Long-Limbed
entries: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

entries.name: Mercantile
entries: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Notorious Slavers
entries: Whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} related to the buying, selling, or controlling of slaves, you are considered proficient in the check. If you would already be proficient, you instead have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}.

entries.name: Spicer
entries: You are proficient in spicer's kit.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Pyke. The Pyke language is characterized by its multisyllable grunts.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Quarren reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Quarren desire for equal rights causes them to tend toward balanced, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Quarren typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh about 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Climb
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Ink Cloud
entries: As an action, you can expel ink in a 10-foot cone. When you do so, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Constitution modifier). On a failed save, a creature is {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} until the end of its next turn. This ability has no effect on constructs. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Keen Hearing
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Quarrenese. The Quarrenese language is characterized by its garbled nature that evokes an image of speaking underwater.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Quermians reach adulthood in their early teens and live a little under a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Querians philosophic culture causes them to tend toward light alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Quermians typically stand 7 to 8 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Diplomatic
entries: You have proficiency with {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

entries.name: Four-Armed
entries: Quermians have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).

entries.name: Natural Empathy
entries: Quermians' talent at reading the body language of others allow them to sense the emotions in those around them. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks to determine emotions against humanoids and beasts within 10 feet of you.

entries.name: Two Brains
entries: When you make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. Once you've done so, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can do so again.

entries.name: Watchful
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Quermian. You can also communicate with other quermians more effectively through a thorough understanding of body language that xenobiologists widely attribute to latent telepathy.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Rakata reach adulthoood by 20 and rarely live longer than 90 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Rakata's propensity towards war and aggression cause them to tend toward lawful dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Rakata typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 180 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Adaptive Resilience
entries: Prolongued use of technology allows rakata to readily adapt to its effects. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength and Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Cannibalize
entries: If you spend at least 1 minute devouring the corpse of a beast or humanoid, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your claws are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Force-Insensitive
entries: While rakata can be manipulated by many {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, they can not sense the Force. You can not use {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or take levels in {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} classes.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Technician
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Rakata. Rakata is characterized by its deep tones and simplistic nature, using mainly consonants and long vowels. It's script seems to be a very ancient form of {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Dexterity or Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Rattataki reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Rattataki are self-serving and violent which causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Rattataki typically stand about 5 and a half feet tall and weigh 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 35 feet.

entries.name: Acrobatic
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Intimidating
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

entries.name: Unarmed Combatant
entries: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Rattataki. Rattataki is known for have an inordinate amount of curses.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Rishii reach adulthood at 10 and generally live no longer than 60 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Rishii tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Rishii range from 4 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh less than 130 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Flight
entries: You have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. While wearing medium or {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, your flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced by half.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

entries.name: Mimicry
entries: You can mimic sounds you have heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds you make can tell they are imitations with a successful Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check opposed by your Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Rishii. Rishii's clicks, trills, and whistles are difficult for outsiders to learn without the aid of a protocol droid, and so Rishii often feel comfortable speaking to eachother in the language in front of others.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence or Charisma score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Ryn reach adulthood in their early teens and live about 80 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Ryn's superstitious and solitary nature causes them to tend toward balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Ryn typically stand 4 and a half to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 120 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Con Artist
entries: You have proficiency in one gaming set of your choice.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Divination
entries: Whether through mystical divination or sheer luck, you can turn failures into successes. When you roll a 1 on the {@dice d20} for an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

entries.name: Eternal Nomads
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

entries.name: Musical
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb} and one musical instrument of your choice.

entries.name: Prehensile Tail
entries: You have supreme control over your tail and can use it to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Ryn. Ryn uses tones and inflections and is easily described as melodious by anyone who hears it. You can communicate with droids and other ryn without using words through the use of your beak.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Selkath reach adulthood in their late teens and live up to 100 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Selkath have been renowned for countless millenia of the careful preservation of neutrality. As such individuals tend towards the neutral balanced alignment, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Selkath typically stand between 4 and a half to 5 and a half feet tall and average 130 pounds. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your claws are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}. Lastly, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can perform a special claw attack. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, and it must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Constitution modifier). On a failed save, the target is {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} until the end of its next turn, and you can't use this feature again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Gift of the Progenitor
entries: You know the {@i temporary boost} at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i kolto pack} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per day. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i kolto cloud} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per day. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You do not require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for these powers.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Selkatha. Selkatha has a very moist and gurgling tone to it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Selonians reach adulthood in their mid teens and live for about 75 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Selonians are serious and den-focused, causing them to tend towards lawful balanced, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Selonians typically stand 6 to 7 feet tall and generally weigh about 180 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 35 feet.

entries.name: Climb
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 35 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Nimble Agility
entries: Your reflexes and agility allow you to move with a burst of {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} until the end of the tum. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

entries.name: Tail and Claw
entries: Your strong tail and razor-sharp claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 35 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Mandaba. Selonians use the name "Home Talk" to refer to their own language.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Shistavanen reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Shistavanen are private and tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Shistavanen typically stand around 6 feet tall and weigh between 140 and 190 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Forced March
entries: Shistavanen are able to maintain a fast pace longer than other species. Shistavanen have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb} due to prolongued travel, as described in Chapter 8.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve hearing or smell.

entries.name: Regenerative
entries: When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a Hit Die to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} as long as the damage would not reduce your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to 0.

entries.name: Tooth and Nail
entries: Your fangs and claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Shistavanen. The Shistavanen language is characterized by its barks and growls.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Squibs reach adulthood at nine years of age and live an average of sixty-five years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Squibs' cheerful nature causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Squibs typically stand 3 to 3 and a half feet tall and weigh around 50 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Your sharp teeth are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Business Savvy
entries: A common trait of all Squibs is their desire and love of haggling. Squibs believe a deal is done when both sides believe they got the better of the other. Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check involving haggling you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Flexible Cheeks
entries: Squibs have flexible cheeks in which they can store small goods. You can store up to two items that weigh a combined total of no more than 2 lb. in your cheeks, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) checks made to {@optfeature Conceal|sw5e-phb|conceal} them.

entries.name: Hide
entries: Your thick hide is naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Sensitive Fur
entries: Squibs' fur is exceptionally sensitive to physical details. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on touch.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Squibbian. The Squibbian language originated as a secret form of communication for Squibs to convey information without being understood.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Ssi-ruuk reach adulthood in their early teens and live to between 100 and 120 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Ssi-ruuk's cultural drive to enslave and entech others cause them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Ssi-ruuk typically stand between 6 or 7 feet tall and weigh over 300 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 35 feet.

entries.name: Type
entries: Your creature type is both beast and humanoid.

entries.name: Force-Insensitive
entries: While Ssi-ruuk can be manipulated by many {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, they can not sense the Force. You can not use {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or take levels in {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} classes.

entries.name: Hunter
entries: You are proficient in {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Natural Empathy
entries: Ssi-ruuk have scent-tongues that let them read the emotions of individuals. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks to determine emotions against humanoids and beasts within 10 feet of you.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb|perceive} is in direct sunlight.

entries.name: Thick Skin
entries: You have tough, scaly skin and prefer not to wear clothes. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Tooth and Nail
entries: Your fangs and claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Ssi-ruuvi. Ssi-ruuvi is a language of musical whistles, honks and clicks, and is nigh impossible for humans and similar species to speak.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Sullustan reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Sullustans' outgoing and friendly nature cause them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Sullustans typically stand 4 and a half to 5 feet tall and weigh around 120 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Keen Hearing
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing.

entries.name: Mercantile
entries: Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check related to conducting business, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Pilot
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, Sullestese, and one more language of your choice. Sullestese is characterized as a robust language in business, and as such is commonly learned by professional merchants.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Talz reach adulthood at 10 and rarely live longer than 50 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Talz' peaceful and slow-to-anger nature cause them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Talz stand between 6 and 8 feet tall and weigh around 250 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your vision can easily cut through {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Hide
entries: You have a thick hide. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 12 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, your thick hide is naturally adapted to cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide.

entries.name: Long-Limbed
entries: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Talzzi. You can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it. Talzzi is characterized by its high-pitched chirps and buzzes.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Dexterity score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Tarasins reach adulthood at 10 and live less than 80 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Tarasins' curious yet composed nature causes them to tend toward balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Tarasins typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 130 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Chameleon Skin
entries: Your scales are translucent, allowing your color-shifting skin to help you blend into your surroundings. You have proficiency in the {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skill. Additionally, you can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

entries.name: Jungle Dweller
entries: Growing up in the jungles of Cularin has left an impact. You don't treat jungle terrain as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}.

entries.name: Naturalist
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Sa'tosin Sense
entries: Tarasins have short spines called sa'tosin that allow them to sense the use of the Force. You are constantly under the effects of the {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} {@i sense force}, though the power does not require {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} for you.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Tarasinese. You can communicate non-verbally with other tarasins through use of a complex system of skin color changes.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Taung reach adulthood at 13 and live to around 85, though they rarely live even half the length as they naturally can due to their deadly lifestyles as Mandalorians.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: The taung live by the traditions and honor-bound code of the Mandalorians, making them tend towards a lawful alignment, typically balanced or dark, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Taung typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 210 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Toughness
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

entries.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Taung Weapon Training
entries: You gain proficiency in one {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} and one {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} of your choice.

entries.name: Menacing
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Force Insensitive
entries: While taung can be manipulated by the force, they cannot sense the Force. You can not use {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or take levels in {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} classes.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Mando'a. Mando'a is primarily a spoken language and is very expressive with simple grammar.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Theelin reach adulthood in their late teens and live for about 70 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Theelin's good-nature and positivity despite the dour state of their species causes them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Theelin typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Expressive
entries: You have proficiency in your choice of artist's implements, disguise kits, synthweaver's implements, or one musical instrument of your choice.

entries.name: Performer
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Skill Versatility
entries: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one extra language of your choice.

entries.name: Mutation
entries: Theelin gain unique mutations, a result of cross-breeding with other humanoids. Choose one of the following mutations.

abilityEntry.name: Ability Score Increase:
abilityEntry.entry: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Thisspiasians reach adulthood in their 20s and often live more than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Thisspiasians' emotional composure causes them to tend toward lawful alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Thisspiasians typically stand 5 to 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 300 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your claws are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Cultured
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Four-Armed
entries: Thisspiasians have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).

entries.name: Inscrutable
entries: Your calm demeanor and control make you hard to read. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks made against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on any {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against an effect that would read your thoughts.

entries.name: Prehensile Tail
entries: You have supreme control over your tail and can use it to manipulate objects as well as your hands.

entries.name: Trance
entries: You only need 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, you only need to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it to gain its benefits.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Thisspiasian. Thisspiasian is a complex language characterized by its interlocking sentences and heavy use of sibilants.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Strength, Intelligence, or Charisma score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Tiss'shar reach adulthood in their early teens and live about 80 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Tiss'shar's moral flexibility causes them to tend towards balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Tiss'shar typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your vision can easily cut through {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Predatory Talents
entries: You have proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}, Sleight of Hand, {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If you surprise a creature and hit it with an attack on your first turn in combat, the attack deals an extra 2d6 damage to it. You can use this trait only once per combat.

entries.name: Tooth and Nail
entries: Your sharp teeth and claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage. Lastly, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can perform a special bite attack. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1), and you can't use this trait again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Tiss'shar. Tiss'shar is mainly formed of hisses, shrieks, and lisping vocalizations. As a written language, it has a violent-looking calligraphy of curves and sharp lines.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores increase by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Tognath reach adulthood by 10 and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Tognath are famously dedicated and hard workers, causing them to tend towards balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Tognath typically stand 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Crafters
entries: You have proficiency with one set of artisan's implements of your choice.

entries.name: Exoskeleton
entries: You have a thick exoskeleton. While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Foreign Biology
entries: You cannot breathe oxygen. The tognath have created a breathing apparatus to negate the negative effects of living in an oxygen rich environment, but if your mask is removed while you are in such an environment, you lose consciousness.

entries.name: Life in the Void
entries: You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to necrotic damage, and while exposed to the vacuum of space, you can {@optfeature Survive|sw5e-phb|survive} for a number of hours equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1 hour), instead of a number of rounds.

entries.name: Primitive Nerves
entries: Because of their primitive nervous systems, tognath are immune to most pain, letting them shrug off major injuries. When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to roll a {@dice d12}. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled, and reduce the damage by that total. Once you've used this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Vocalizer
entries: Tognath vocal cords are not made for oxygen rich environments, and rely on a vocalizer to communicate effectively with other species. If your vocalizer is removed or destroyed, your voice becomes quiet and difficult to understand.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Tognath. You can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Dexterity or Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Togorian reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Togorians' rigid sense of honor causes them to tend toward lawful light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Togorians tower over almost all other species, with smaller females standing upwards of 7 feet tall and weighing 250 lbs., while males can easily reach 8 feet tall and weigh around 350 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your claws are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Savage Attacks
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit}.

entries.name: Stealthy Hunter
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} skills.

entries.name: Toughness
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Togorese. Togorese is characterized by its deep, resonating growls.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Toydarians reach adulthood at 10 and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Toydarians' greedy nature causes them to tend toward chaotic balanced, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Toydarians average 4 feet tall and weigh less than 50 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Business Savvy
entries: A common trait of all Toydarians is their shrewd business sense and their ability to haggle any deal. A loyal and proud people, these traits could be off-putting to outsiders, as many Toydarians in the galaxy were seen as crooks or slimy businessmen, but this was not always the case. Whenever you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check involving haggling you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Closed Mind
entries: Toydarian brains have an unusual composition which made them resistant to influence from the Force. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Flight
entries: You have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. While wearing medium or {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, your flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced by half.

entries.name: Shrewd Demeanor
entries: You have proficiency in two Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma skills of your choice.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, {@language Huttese|sw5e-phb|Huttese}, and Toydarian.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Strength score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Ugnaughts reach adulthood at 20 and can live to reach 200.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Ugnaughts tend toward no particular alignment. The best and worst are found among them.

entries.name: Size
entries: Ugnaughts typically stand around 4 feet and weigh about 50 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Your tusks are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Crafters
entries: You have proficiency in one tool of your choice.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Industrial Hazards
entries: You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to acid damage.

entries.name: Tech Dabbler
entries: You know the {@i mending} at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i analyze} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per day. When you reach 5th level, you learn and can cast the {@i overheat} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per day. Your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. You do not require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for these powers.

entries.name: Tinker
entries: You have proficiency with {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements}. You can use these and spend 1 hour and 100 cr worth of materials to construct a Tiny Device (AC 5, 1 hp). You can take the {@action Use an Object|sw5e-phb} action to have your device cause one of the following effects: create a small {@spell Explosion|sw5e-phb|explosion}, create a repeating loud noise for 1 minute, create smoke for 1 minute, cause harmless tremors for 1 minute. You can maintain a number of these devices up to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} at once, and a device stops functioning after 24 hours away from you. You can dismantle the device to reclaim the materials used to create it.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Ugnaught. The Ugnaught language is composed of grunts, squeals, and chatters, and is difficult for other species to learn.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Ugors reach adulthood in their early teens and live about 70 years, though some live to be over 100.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Ugors are loyal to their theocratic state and see outsiders as expendable. Many follow a Lawful Balanced alignment, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Ugors typically stand between 5 and 6 feet tall and weigh 130 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Amorphous Form
entries: You can squeeze through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide, provided you are wearing and carrying nothing. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} you make to initiate or escape a grapple.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Galactic Scavengers
entries: You have proficiency in mechanic's kits or scavenging kits (your choice).

entries.name: Natural Resilience
entries: You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}.

entries.name: Shape Self
entries: If you are not {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}, you can reshape your body to give yourself a head, one or two arms, one or two legs, and makeshift hands and feet, or you can revert to a limbless blob (no action required). As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can extrude a pseudopod that is up to 6 inches wide and 10 feet long or reabsorb it into your body. You can use this pseudopod to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour out the contents of a container. The pseudopod can't attack, activate enhanced items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read and write in {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Ugor. Additionally, Your vocal range allows you to speak languages other species might have difficulty with.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Charisma or Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Umbarans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Umbarans' desire to improve their social standing at all costs causes them to tend towards chaos, though there are exceptions

entries.name: Size
entries: Umbarans typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Superior Darkvision
entries: You've lived most of your life without direct sunlight. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Umbaran Specilization
entries: You have proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}, or {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Tech Dabbler
entries: You know the {@i ward} at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. When you reach 3rd level, you learn and can cast the {@i analyze} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per day. When you reach 5th level, you can also cast the {@i infiltrate} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} once per day. Intelligence is your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} for these powers. You do not require use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for these powers.

entries.name: Shadow People
entries: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by dim light.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb|perceive} is in direct sunlight.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Umbaran. Umbaran is characterized by its blending of technical jargon with informal language. It is rarely spoken off Umbara.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Verpine reach adulthood in their 40's and live an average of 200 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Verpine's altruistic and generous nature cause them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Verpine stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and rarely weigh more than 120 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Crafters
entries: You have proficiency in one tool of your choice.

entries.name: Hardened Carapace
entries: While you are unarmored or wearing {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Tympanic Antennae
entries: You have {@sense Tremorsense|sw5e-phb|tremorsense} out to 30 feet. You can detect and pinpoint the origin of vibrations within that radius, provided that monster and the source of the vibrations are in contact with the same ground or substance. {@sense Tremorsense|sw5e-phb} can't be used to detect flying or incorporeal creatures

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Verpine. You can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, but your vocal cords do not allow you to speak it. You can communicate with other Verpine at distances of up to a mile using your antennae.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Voss reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century. They do not reach sexual maturity until they undergo the Rite of Ardor.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: As Voss culture encourages duty and emotional composure, individuals tend toward a lawful alignment, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Voss typically stand 5 to 6 feet tall and generally weigh about 150 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of grey.

entries.name: Precognition
entries: You see brief visions of the future, that allow you to turn failures into successes. When you roll a 1 on an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

entries.name: Mystic Healing
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Voss Weapon Training
entries: You have proficiency with the {@item Blaster rifle|sw5e-phb} and {@item Techblade|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Inscrutable
entries: Your calm demeanor and control make you hard to read. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks made against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on any {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against an effect that would read your thoughts.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Voss. The Voss language is characterized by it's mystic-sounding word pairings.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Vurk reach adulthood in their 20s and live an average of 70 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Vurk philosophies cause them to tend toward the light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Vurks typically stand between 6 and 7 feet tall and weigh around 175 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 35 feet.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Athletic
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to life underwater, you have superior vision in low light conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Head Crest
entries: Your head crest is a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Semblan. Semblan has a very melodic feel and often evokes images of waterfalls to those who don't understand its meanings.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Xexto reach adulthood at 9 and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Despite being avid thrillseekers, xexto are calm and even tempered, tending them towards balanced alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Xexto typically stand 3 to 5 feet tall and generally weigh about 50 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Small.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 25 feet.

entries.name: Dexterous
entries: You have proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}, or Sleight of Hand.

entries.name: Fearless
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened}.

entries.name: Four-Armed
entries: Xexto have four arms which they can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required).

entries.name: Jungle Dweller
entries: Growing up in the rainforests of Troiken has left an impact. You don't treat jungle terrain as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}.

entries.name: Racer's Reflexes
entries: Whenever you make a Dexterity {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can choose to add 1d4 to the result. You cannot do so again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Split Mind
entries: When you make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. Once you've done so, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can do so again.

entries.name: Treeclimber
entries: You have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} that involve climbing.

entries.name: Undersized
entries: Your small stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, you can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Xextese. Xextese is a blubbering sort of language, with many metaphors for natural phenomenon found in its vocabulary.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Yevetha reach adulthood in their early teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Yevetha's xenophobic attitude causes them to tend toward the dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Yevetha typically stand between 6 and 6 and a half feet tall and generally weigh about 160 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Aggressive
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can move up to your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of your choice that you can see or hear. You must end this move closer to the enemy than you started.

entries.name: Arm Blades
entries: Your retractable dewclaws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d6 kinetic damage.

entries.name: Toughness
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

entries.name: Mechanical Memory
entries: Whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check related to memorizing or duplicating mechanical readouts, you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Yevethan. Yevetha are able to speak other languages, but their isolationist nature makes them tend to reject the languages of other species. Only rarely would a Yevethan speak {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, as this would often decrease their social standing.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Zeltron reach adulthood in their late teens and live about 80 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Zeltron are a deeply sensual, hedonistic species, causing them to tend toward chaotic balanced or dark side alignments, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Zeltron tend to be slender and statuesque, typically standing between 5 and 6 feet tall and rarely weighing more than 150 lb. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Charismatic
entries: You have proficiency with {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} (your choice).

entries.name: Enthralling Pheromones
entries: You can use your pheromones to influence individuals of both sexes. Whenever you roll a 1 on a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. Additionally, once per short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can treat a {@dice d20} roll of 9 or lower on a Charisma check as a 10. This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: Natural Empathy
entries: Zeltron's limited telepathy allow them to sense mood shifts in those around them. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) checks to determine emotions against humanoids and beasts within 10 feet of you.

entries.name: Two Livered
entries: Zeltron have two livers, which makes them adept at filtering toxins. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}, and you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage (explained in chapter 9).

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one language of your choice.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Zilkin are considered adults at 4 years old, and rarely live to be over 12.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Zilkin have an outspoken but just nature that causes them to tend towards lawful light side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Zilkin stand between 1 and 2 feet tall and weigh around 10 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Tiny.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 20 feet.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to life underwater, you have superior vision in low light conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Pintsized
entries: Your tiny stature makes it hard for you to wield bigger weapons. You can't use medium or heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. Additionally, you can't wield weapons with the two-handed or versatile property, and you can only wield one-handed weapons in two hands unless they have the light property.

entries.name: Puny
entries: Zilkin are too small to pack much of a punch. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, and when determining your bonus to attack and damage rolls for weapon attacks using Strength, you can't add more than +3.

entries.name: Quick Learner
entries: When using downtime for learning a new language or training with a set of tools, it takes half the amount of time and credits necessary to complete.

entries.name: Small and Nimble
entries: You are too small and fast to effectively target. You have a +1 bonus to AC, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

entries.name: Strong-Legged
entries: When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Swim
entries: You have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 20 feet.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Zilkin. Zilkin is characterized by loud, croaking noises from the throat, supported by air stored in the chin.

abilityEntry.name: Ability Score Increase:
abilityEntry.entry: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

entries.name: Ability Score Increase
entries: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and your Intelligence score increases by 1.

entries.name: Age
entries: Zygerrians reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Zygerrian culture's emphasis on subjugation and strength causes them to tend towards chaotic dark side, though there are exceptions.

entries.name: Size
entries: Zygerrians normally stand between 5 to 6 feet tall and weigh about 140 lbs. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 30 feet.

entries.name: Acrobatic
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage and have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have a cat's keen senses, especially in the dark. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Notorious Slavers
entries: Whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} related to the buying, selling, or controlling of slaves, you are considered proficient in the check. If you would already be proficient, you instead have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}.

entries.name: Reputation for Cruelty
entries: You are proficient in {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}, as well as the {@item Saberwhip|sw5e-phb|saberwhip} and {@item Vibrowhip|sw5e-phb|vibrowhip}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and Zygerrian. Zygerrian is characterized by its subtle growls and purrs.

entries.name: Biology and Appearance
entries: The hulking abyssin have long limbs and a single large eye that dominates their foreheads. Typically well-muscled, the abyssin's stooping gait results in a slightly hunched appearance.

A distinctive trait of the abyssin is their ability to heal quickly; their fast regeneration is believed to have been an adaptation to prevent fluid loss via bleeding on their desert homeworld. All cells in the abyssin body are replaced every 80 hours, and organs which typically were paired in other species appear singularly.

entries.name: Society and Culture
entries: A primitive tribal society, the abyssin of Byss are known as violent and brutish, and their planet is avoided by most beings in the civilized galaxy. Unstable resources on Byss do not allow for mass population growth or for the stabilization of a central government, economy or trade system.

Existing simply in nomadic tribes, abyssin groups can interact peacefully with one another, though only if both groups have plentiful water and food supplies.
